primary_computational_methods.description: No new algorithms, statistical methods, or computational pipelines developed. The evidence-grading schema was adopted from Shekelle et al. (1999) and Barnes et al. (2020).

data_sources: Existing systematic reviews on catatonia treatment and epidemiology
Primary literature (RCTs, observational studies, case series, case reports)
Cochrane reviews (e.g., Zaman et al., 2019 on benzodiazepines)
Meta-analyses (e.g., Leroy et al., 2018 on ECT; Solmi et al., 2018 on prevalence)
Electronic healthcare record databases cited in secondary analyses (e.g., Rogers et al., 2021)
Existing national and international clinical guidelines (NICE TA59, APA, WFSBP)
methods_used: Meta-analysis results (referenced, not conducted de novo)
Cluster analysis (referenced from Peralta and Cuesta, 2001)
Standardised mean difference calculation (referenced from Leroy et al., 2018)
